bio_am: Ախլաթի Սոխորդ գիւղէն։ Տարօնի ժողովրդական հերոսը, սպաննուեցաւ Գելիեգուզանի մէջ՝ 1899-ին։
bio_en: Serob Vardanian, known as Aghbyur ('Brother') Serob, was a tall, handsome villager of Sokhord near Akhlat, on the slopes of Mount Nemrut, whom Hrayr called the people's hero and 'lion of Taron'. In autumn 1895, as the Hamidian massacres spread, he returned to his village with a 27-man band, spreading his men among the threatened villages so that the Akhlat villages they guarded escaped massacre and looting; he was a peerless marksman and once escaped fifty regular soldiers alone on Nemrut in winter. In 1897 he received on Mount Nemrut the arms brought from Persia by Hakob Jartar's band. Hunted by the government with the help of Armenian informers, he was surrounded in autumn 1899 at Geliyeguzan in Sasun by Ali bey's troops and some 1,500 Kurds and killed with his companions; his wife Sose was wounded, and his severed head was displayed in Mush.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Death year from Droshak Dec 1899 (#670).
